newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates' press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The founding committee of Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank has announced the allotment of shares for 221,500 subscribers in what is being billed as the world's largest Islamic bank.
- Dubai police arrest two Indians, two Pakistanis and a Yemeni man for misuse of the Internet.
- Transgulf Industrial Investment Co plans to set up the region's first project in Oman for the production of both ferrochrome and ferrosilicon, the company said.
- Two new FM stations are to open in the UAE emirate of Umm al-Quwain in October.
- The Saadiyat Free Zone will soon float ordinary shares and Global Depository Receipts with $1 billion to investors, the free zone authorities in Abu Dhabi said.
- The Dubai municipality granted 3,078 building licences in the first half of this year.
- Abu Dhabi earmarked 1.1 billion dirhams to expand its international airport.
- Syria and Jordan praised the UAE president's call for an Arab summit.
- Gulf study calls for the use of the Arabic language as a means of communication in hospitals and clinics.
